<div class="card-body">
'''Electrobinoculars''' is a [[Light]] [[Device]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">電子双眼鏡</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">１フォース消費して、任意の戦士に配備する。好きな時に２フォース消費して、リザーブデッキの一番上のカードを見ることができる。見たカードは、フォースデッキの一番上へ置くこともできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-35o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">遠方の対象を、コンピュータ処理で拡大し、正確な距離を表示する。暗視機能も備える。頑丈なボディが内部回路を保護している。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Electrobinoculars.

'''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy on any warrior. At any time, you may use 2 Force to look at the top card of your Reserve Deck. You may put that card on top of your Force Pile.

'''Lore:''' Computer processing magnifies distant targets and displays their exact distance. Also provides night vision. A sturdy housing protects the internal circuitry.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Electrobinoculars]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
